about: Course thumbnails for docs/Course_Catalogue_Website.xlsx (Course Master (2) record IDs). Every course has an image chosen from the existing artwork by subject first, then grade, level, language and course type; each reason says why. A source without a leading slash is a file in public/Thumbnail Samples; one with a leading slash is a path under public/. Originals are never changed. Build: python3 scripts/build-course-thumbnails.py
